trainable: every head.* parameter except BatchNorm (stems, cls/reg/obj convs and preds); backbone/FPN frozen; all BatchNorm in eval mode
loss: existing YOLOX P2 loss (IoU box, BCE cls) with the existing SigmoidFocalObjectnessLoss: assigned positives always supervised; known negatives ONLY inside reviewed clean negative support; every other anchor UNKNOWN (zero gradient)
data: docs/acne-data-v2-manifest-20261015.json pilotOrder: 540 TRAIN positive product tiles + 60 reviewed-negative tiles (every 10th), fixed seed order

evaluation.rule: one fixed product evaluator for Step0 and pilot: product photo_input tiles, conf obj*cls>=.30, hard NMS .30, current staging anatomical filter, IoU>=.50 one-to-one

sets.trainProbe: first 40 distinct TRAIN photos of the pilot order that have a replay snapshot (learning on training examples, NOT generalisation)
sets.development: Scope B 12 photos/14 fixed targets + 9 reviewed negative photos FP, and the 3 product-pass controls/29 targets (browser preflight; exposed development/regression)
sets.unusedEval: UNUSED_EVAL_CANDIDATE photos that pass the replayed product gates (eyewear UNKNOWN): pre-registered by rule before any model output; candidates outside labels are UNKNOWN, not FP

decision.A: development: >=2 targets gained and 0 lost vs Step0 over Scope B+controls, reviewed-negative FP <= Step0; unused eval: >=3 targets gained and lost <= gained/3; train probe recall not lower
decision.B: otherwise (including any development target lost or FP increase)
decision.frozen: no threshold, denominator or rule change after seeing results; no automatic longer training

budget.process: single heavy process under HeavyJobLease (1350 MiB private peak / 1600 MiB available, the CDC training precedent); the desktop VM ends every call after <=180 s, so training resumes from the 25-step checkpoints and evaluation resumes per photo
budget.environment: python 3.10, torch 1.12.1 CPU, numpy 1.26.4, opencv-headless 4.12.0, scikit-image 0.25.2 (only CPU torch reachable here)
budget.checkpoints: every 25 steps: model, optimizer moments, scheduler, torch/python/numpy RNG, CURRENT pointer
